pokedexEntries.bk: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

pokedexEntries.wh: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other’s school.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
